basis_of_record.documents: RL-REVISED Highland Condos Plumbing 10-29-07 (P2.01-P2.07, P3.02); A2.03 and A3.11 (04-02-07); S3.8 (04-02-07)
basis_of_record.note: Proposed parallel install and stack-by-stack cutover. Every new element is assumed; nothing here is engineered.

conflicts.note: Same issue (10-29-07). Resolved by owner decision 2026-11-06: 1-1/2 in governs (P2.03), as modeled.

conflicts.topic: P3.02 stack numbers vs plan locations
conflicts.note: Plan stacks are named A-F by location. F is matched to P3.02 '03' because both stop one floor short of R5. A, B, C and E are not matched to 01, 02, 04 and 05.

sources: P3.02: 04 stack has four branch groups
conflicts.note: This model gives A, B, C and E an R1 branch each (20 groups). P3.02 implies 19: one of the four has no R1 branch, and which one is unresolved.

assumptions.basis: Floor + 108 in. P3.02 draws each branch group at the ceiling of the floor it serves; the Unit 107 study (highland/water) holds overhead CW at floor + 108 in. No document gives riser takeoff heights.
350.5 ft. P1 garage main hung below the R1 slab; S3.8 gives the drop-slab soffit at 351.21 ft near Unit 107. The garage soffit along the main is not established.
4.0 in c/c. Riser symbols are not drawn to scale.
24.0 in. Branches continue per the typical unit plans (P4.0x), which this model does not trace. Stub direction points away from Corridor 108.
CPVC, per the owner's report of failing CPVC (highland/installation). P0.01 material notes were not used; installed material is not field verified.

strategy: Parallel install alongside the live system, then one stack at a time cutover

sequence.what: Floor protection, dust walls and egress signage at each work area
New garage main alongside the live main; heat trace and insulate CW (P2.02 note)
Open Corridor 108 ceiling; new header alongside the live header; test
Stack F: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Stack E: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Stack C: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Stack B: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Stack A: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Stack D: open chase per floor, install new riser, firestop, test, shut down stack, cut over floor branches, cap and abandon or remove the old riser
Patch, tape and paint openings; reinstate ceilings; remove protection
